messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a spike in provisional token charges in Canary yesterday. Looks like fallback routing + prefetch caused double-counting when model was swapped mid-stream.

oliver: repro? which route?

maya: /v1/chat/stream from webhooks-prod, rate-limit fallback triggered to low-cost pool, meanwhile autoscaler swapped from opt-quant to opt-quant-v2 mid-session.

sam: logs:
```
INFO session_id=abc123 route=webhooks-prod fallback=rate_limit -> routed_to=pool-B model=opt-quant-v2
BILLING provisional: +320 tokens (prefetch)
CONFIRMATION: +480 tokens (after resume)
```

maya: result: user sees provisional + confirmed in dashboard, end up double-billed until reconcile restores one.

ci-bot: monitoring alert #billing-ops triggered 1797771300 — provisional_spike > threshold 

tess: console shows provisional and confirmed as separate lines; doesn't group by session_id. UX request: show provisional as tentative and auto-collapse if confirmed.

reza: root cause is attribution key. When midstream model swap happens we lose original model tag on subsequent chunks so ledger attributes to both. Short-term fix: attach `session_start_model` to every chunk/ack so attribution uses that first value unless explicit model_change event.

oliver: agree. alternative: keep routing sticky to initial pool for session TTL or treat fallback routes as transient and credit to origin. Both have tradeoffs.

sam: quick mitigation: in billing pipeline, if provisional flag + same session_id within 30s, dedupe by token prefix heuristic. Not perfect but lowers noise.

maya: any perf/regressions? preferring minimal change.

reza: adding `session_start_model` is low-risk; just propagate from router to downstream and include in trace headers: `X-Session-Model: opt-quant`.

tess: I'll prototype UI change — show "tentative" badge and a link to reconcile history. cc @maya @oliver

oliver: can someone open a short RFC? include telemetry dashboard panels: per-session provisional/confirmed, model-change events overlay.

maya: opened: https://r.infra/rr/1234

sam: will throw a small patch into billing dedupe and run canary.

maya: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10am if canary shows reduction. :thumbsup:
